reasoning: Your private thoughts before you answer, in character and in the first person. One or two sentences. Nothing here is said out loud.
dialogue: What you say out loud, in character. An empty string when you say nothing.
actions: What you ask the host to do, as a list. Every entry is an object with "name" and "arguments". Empty when you do nothing.
actionsIntro: The actions you may take are:

end_conversation.description: End the conversation with the player.

emote.description: Show a gesture or an expression, such as a nod or a shrug.
emote.kind: The gesture or expression, such as a nod or a shrug.
